title: Monitoring, Digests, and Early-Warning Operations
principles: Every alert exposes the trigger, supporting evidence, freshness state, and known limitations.
A missing event record is not evidence that a hazard or condition is absent.
Modeled warning signals remain distinct from source alerts and are not emergency instructions.
Digests remain drafts until a human explicitly reviews and approves publication.
No hidden composite risk score is created.
No individual tracking, automated consequential action, or automatic emergency dispatch is allowed.
